summary: Extends RSVP so some sessions can be given priority when the network is congested and there is not room for everyone. That raises the chance that important sessions, such as emergency or government calls, can still be set up. It is a standards-track specification.

eli5.summary: When a theme park is full, some guests with a special pass still get in. This lets certain network connections get a special pass when the network is crowded.

questions: how to prioritize sessions during congestion
